aid.title: Virginia Tech - International Students (University Scholarships and Financial Aid)

cds.title: Virginia Tech Common Data Set 2025-2026 (C13 application fee)

test_policy.notes: Test-optional for students entering through Fall 2028; applicants choose whether scores are reviewed and not submitting does not affect the decision. SAT/ACT writing sections are not reviewed. Also optional for international applicants.

requirements.supplemental_essays: None required; optional Additional Information prompt on Common App.
requirements.notes: Letters of recommendation are not required or requested and are not considered. Self-reported STARS record (or transcripts for students who studied outside the U.S.) due Dec 1 (EA) / Jan 24 (RD). Fee of $60 comes from CDS 2025-26 C13 (last cycle); the 2026-27 fee was not stated on the pages opened. Admission is reviewed by requested major.

deadlines.label: Early Action (non-binding), fall 2027
deadlines.notes: Notified late February. STARS/transcripts and English test results due Dec 1. Reply due May 1. Virginia Tech has no early decision.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision (space available), fall 2027
deadlines.notes: Notified mid-March. STARS/transcripts and English test results due Jan 24.

deadlines.label: General Scholarship application and FAFSA deadline
deadlines.notes: For maximum scholarship and aid consideration; FAFSA priority date March 1.

deadlines.label: Deadline to accept an offer of admission (EA and RD)

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waived if the applicant completed four years of study (grades 9-12) in a native English-speaking country (US, UK, Ireland, Australia, NZ, Canada except Quebec, Singapore, Ghana, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa and others listed), English-only instruction, no ESL. Also met by SAT EBRW 550, ACT English 24, IGCSE/GCSE/GCE English A-C (6-9), or IB English A 5+. Tests must be within two years; MyBest, TOEFL Essentials and ITP not accepted.

english.notes: Old 0-120 scale. The page prints the date qualifier ambiguously (both TOEFL lines read 'on or after January 21, 2026'); this is the 0-120 line.
New scale, exams on or after 2026-01-21.
Cambridge English score of 176 or higher.

aid.notes: Need-based aid requires a valid FAFSA (US citizen/eligible noncitizen) or Virginia VASA. International students who cannot file either may still apply for college and departmental scholarships via Scholarship Central after applying.

ielts.note: Page says to specify CEEB code 5859 on the IELTS/TOEFL/PTE test form.

tier_notes.arts_design: School of Architecture + Design is nationally ranked.
